key_insight: PMosFM learns physics-constrained generation in intrinsic manifold coordinates, enabling one-step sampling while preserving physical constraints and distributional fidelity.
engineering_relevance: It reduces the training and inference overhead of constraint enforcement, making physics-aware generative modeling more practical for fast scientific simulation and design.
method: Encode constraints with a manifold decoder so transport happens in intrinsic coordinates.
Use a geometric preconditioner plus a covariance whitening transform to improve conditioning.
Train with a finite-interval objective that matches velocities and decoded physical endpoints without residual unrolling.
evidence_signal: The paper reports controlled ablations and benchmark experiments showing lower training and sampling time than multi-step baselines at comparable physical and distributional fidelity.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate manifold decoding and stable conditioning, so imperfect decoder geometry or whitening may limit gains in harder problems.
paper_title: PMosFM: Preconditioned Manifold Matching for One-Step Physics-Constrained Generation
